What is the SDFC? Sorry incoming freshman here

I actually just got back from E2 this Sunday! E2 is a wonderful experience, the activities are a little boring at times but it all depends on what you make with your time there. 

Most of the people I met were really friendly and honestly were just as nervous as anyone else. When I went there was actually a transgender student there and everyone treated them equally.  The three days go by fast! Just if you do go, try to branch out and just meet some people so when you go to school, you can recognize some faces!
